caveats: Sampling is approximately once per second; short-lived peaks/processes can be missed. GPU values are whole-device and RAM/disk values are whole-system where labeled. Other applications can affect them.

Owned process memory includes the harness and observed descendant model/browser processes. RSS can double-count shared pages. Private committed memory and RSS measure different things and are never added.
Per-phase peaks come from samples within that phase. Cumulative worker high-water marks in per-call usage are deliberately excluded.
Logical process I/O does not prove physical SSD traffic. Whole-system disk deltas include unrelated activity; they cannot establish ARC-specific disk throughput or paging.

Generation speed is native generated tokens divided by native generation time; median across generation calls is compared. It excludes tool/network waits. Research/file wall time includes those waits, reasoning, prefills, model switches and saving.

The fixed generation phase has three capped 512-token samples; its pass criterion is at least 400 native generated tokens per sample, not completion of the deliberately longer prose request. Each web/research/file workload has one run per configuration, without randomization or repeated-trial confidence intervals.
Native generation tokens may include reasoning and structured tool arguments; they are not solely visible answer tokens. Vision call measurements are shown separately from the chat model.

Only full runs enter the comparison; focused retests remain in the evidence archive. The leading table uses the newest per-mode full run with hashes matching the newest completed normal baseline. Missing modes await comparable runs. A run completing means the harness ended, not that every workload passed.
Native prompt timings depend on caching and actual input length; different research or chunk decisions can make per-mode task throughput non-comparable.
Cold model load means a new ARC model worker/server, not an emptied OS file cache or a cold SSD. No OS-cache flushing was performed.

Resident reuse verifies prepareTextModel reused the loaded text model after a five-second idle period following the workloads. It does not establish hours of idle retention or uninterrupted residency across temporary vision-model switches.
A persisted file passing syntax and exact-line checks does not prove general coding correctness. The 1,000-line task tests literal file delivery and continuation, not complex software design.

Vision/tool completion is mechanically checked; source correctness and screenshot content require artifact review. No failed or unfinished phase is converted into a successful task by these summaries.

Runs on one Windows PC using Arc Focus at 16K context do not establish behavior on 4/8/12/24GB GPUs, other models, Mac/AMD/Intel, or Strata. Low-VRAM tiers preserve the selected model/context and benchmark limits are targets, not universal workload guarantees.
privacy: Private runtime paths, device identities and credential-shaped fields are omitted/redacted. Public source URLs, model/backend identifiers and source hashes are retained for review.
